nameOrigin: initials for ‘Little Green Man’ i.e. an alien

pokedexEntries.bk: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.

pokedexEntries.wh: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

pokedexEntries.as: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

pokedexEntries.us: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

pokedexEntries.um: This Pokémon is shrouded in mystery. It’s said to have appeared from a UFO that fell from the sky about 50 years ago.

pokedexEntries.sw: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.
